title: Congress councillors stage fake note protest over Ludhiana sweeping project
seoTitle: Ludhiana MC protest over sweeping project

tea.why: Councillors opposed an ₹82-crore mechanical sweeping project and other municipal agendas.
tea.want: To halt the mechanical sweeping project and demand transparency regarding outsourced workers.
tea.changed: Oct 12: Municipal Corporation House passed 34 agendas amid opposition protests and scuffles.

summary: Congress councillors, joined by members of other parties, staged demonstrations at the Ludhiana Municipal Corporation to oppose a proposed ₹82-crore mechanical sweeping project. Initially carrying sacks of counterfeit currency as a symbolic gesture of opposition during a General House meeting, the protesters later engaged in strong resistance during the resumed session at Guru Nanak Dev Bhawan. Alongside the sweeping project, contentious proposals included the extension of contracts for outsourced sanitation workers. Opposition members argued against the passage of these items, citing financial viability and procedural concerns, and announced plans to approach the Punjab and Haryana High Court. The meetings featured intense debates, walkouts, and scuffles.
demands: Provide complete ward-wise details of outsourced sanitation workers
Allow zero-hour discussions for ward-related issues
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Congress councillor Gaurav Bhatti protested with sacks of counterfeit notes at the Municipal Corporation General House meeting.
The House passed 34 agendas amid protests, scuffles, and a walkout by over 300 sanitation workers.
